title: INT8 weight-only cross-validation canary + failure-injection playbook for GPTQ/AWQ profiles
creator: Sofia Martinez
description:
Summary: Create an end-to-end integration and regression testing playbook that validates INT8 weight-only quantization profiles (GPTQ and AWQ variants) across calibration, inference performance, and accuracy drift boundaries. This ticket focuses on three pillars: automated cross-validation harnesses, staged canary rollout with telemetry gates, and a failure-injection suite to validate graceful degradation and rollback logic.

Background: We have several existing quantization test assets (calibration harnesses, nightly golden evals). However, we lack a reproducible cross-validation workflow that exercises profile selection, calibration artifacts, and runtime fallbacks in a canary flow. Recent spacing of INT8 weight-only profiles across architectures has surfaced intermittent accuracy regressions on long-context workloads; this playbook codifies how we detect and respond.

Goals:
- Provide a deterministic pipeline that runs GPTQ and AWQ profile variants against a curated eval set and production-like prompts.
- Implement canary rollout orchestration (10% -> 50% -> 100%) with automated telemetry gates (accuracy regressions, token-level latency, reject-rate).
- Add a failure-injection harness that simulates KV cache eviction, partial kernel fallback, and high memory pressure to assert rollback behaves correctly.
- Ensure CI/regression coverage: nightly smoke, pre-release canary smoke, and blocking CI guard for major profile changes.

Acceptance Criteria (minimum):
- Cross-validation CI job created that: runs GPTQ/AWQ profile pairs across 3 model sizes (small/medium/large), captures top-line metrics, and uploads artifacts to the quant-profiles dashboard.
- Canary orchestration implemented as a release recipe: traffic split automation, telemetry gates, automatic rollback on threshold breach. Playbook docs (Confluence) and runbook for SRE created.
- Failure-injection suite with 5 deterministic scenarios; each scenario has expected failure modes and automated detection hooks.
- Regression gating: PRs that modify quantization profiles must pass the cross-validation CI and not increase median token error on the golden eval by more than 0.5% (configurable).
- Dashboards: accuracy histograms, per-token latency, distribution of calibration shift, and per-profile drift alerts (kept for 90 days).

Out-of-scope: FP8 exploration (separate initiative), deep automl for profile tuning, and UI edits to Console (only dashboard wiring for visibility).

Implementation plan:
1) Cross-validation harness (week 1-2):
   - Reuse the existing calibration pipeline but add a profile matrix runner that executes GPTQ and AWQ weight-only variants side-by-side on the same prompt corpus.
   - Capture per-example token-by-token logits and proto-diff artifact for deterministic regression comparisons.
   - Artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-qa/quant-profiles/ENG-43921/<date>/ with manifest.json.
   - PR: github.com/redwood-inference/quant-ci/pull/1245 (draft).

2) Canary orchestration (week 2-3):
   - Implement recipe in rollout service: traffic splits, model-pin override, and automatic fallback.
   - Define telemetry gates: accuracy delta > 0.005 absolute, tail latency (p95) increase > 20ms, error rate increase > 0.5%.
   - Add automatic rollback and incident label creation if gate triggers.
   - Playbook doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/QP/ENG-43921-Canary-Playbook (draft).

3) Failure-injection suite (week 3):
   - Scenarios: KV eviction during long-context generation, quantized-kernel degrade toggled, simulated noisy CPU/GPU contention, partial model chunk failure, and synthetic OOM then soft-fallback.
   - Harness will run under a canary namespace and assert correctness of fallback (serve compatible variant or fail-open to a less-quantized model).
   - Github PR: github.com/redwood-inference/inference-tests/pull/431.

4) Telemetry and dashboards (parallel):
   - Telemetry events: profile_id, calibration_seed, median_token_error, top_k_accuracy, latency_ms, fallback_reason.
   - Wire alerts into Opsgenie/SLOs for on-call awareness.
   - Dashboard: Quant Profiles -> Crossvalidation view (metrics described in acceptance criteria).

Test plan:
- Unit tests for artifact manifest, profile matcher, and telemetry schema.
- Integration tests run in CI with small model mocks to assert end-to-end flow.
- Nightly run with full models and golden eval; compare with previous baseline and produce a regression report.
- Canary verification: run the canary recipe in staging with injected failures to validate rollback paths.

Rollout & Monitoring:
- Start with internal canary on staging, then limited production canary (10%) for 48 hours, if stable progress to 50% for 24 hours, then full rollout.
- If telemetry gate trips at any phase, immediate rollback to previous profile and create incident with telemetry snapshot.
- Maintain a changelog of profile checksum hashes and calibration seed for reproducibility.

Trade-offs / Decisions:
- Deterministic per-token comparisons increase storage cost; keep raw tokens for 14 days and summarized diffs for 90 days.
- Using a conservative accuracy gate (0.5% median) to avoid noisy rollouts; we can tune this after two full canaries.
- Failure injection will initially be simulated (no real user impact) but later run as controlled production chaos tests behind feature flags.

Risks / Blockers:
- Some AWQ variants are non-deterministic across runs on different GPU kernels; need to normalize kernel settings or tag such profiles as non-deterministic.
- Dashboard ingestion missing schema fields (blocked by telemetry infra team) — dependency: ENG-37123 (tracked separately).

Artifacts / Links:
- Draft PR (harness): github.com/redwood-inference/quant-ci/pull/1245
- Failure inject tests: github.com/redwood-inference/inference-tests/pull/431
- Playbook doc (draft): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/QP/ENG-43921-Canary-Playbook
- Golden eval corpus: drive.redwood.ai/quant/golden-eval/2025-02
- Dashboard prototype: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/quant/quant-profiles-crossvalidation

Next steps / immediate tasks:
- (Sofia) finalize cross-validation runner interface and open the initial PR (in progress).
- (Arjun) prototype telemetry schema and coordinate with infra for ingestion (blocker: ETA 3 days).
- (ML Eng) provide curated prompt corpus and nominal baseline outputs.

Contacts:
- PM: Lina Zhou
- ML Lead: Marco Ricci
- SRE: Priya Nair

Notes: This ticket is intended to be the canonical integration/regression checklist for any INT8 weight-only profile changes going forward. Keep the playbook concise and automatable so that product and infra teams can adopt it for Dedicated and Private deployments as well.

Dashboards and alerts wired to Opsgenie with retention policy set
